messages:
Kara (PM): Quick sync: customers want an on-prem upgrade that keeps their public footprint identical and supports tiny airgap deltas. Need acceptance criteria + runbook.
Vik (Eng): We can support binary/asset delta bundles + a migration runner that supports --simulate and --resume. Key: reversible migrations and checksum validation.
Mona (Eng-Infra): Define "public footprint": we can guarantee LB VIPs and NAT egress ranges. Pod IPs and internal host IPs are out of scope. Call this behavior 'preserve-mode'.
Sam (Field): Field note: NetOps will block any change that touches route tables or public IPs. They want a single PASS/FAIL preflight and a short remediation list they can hand to their network team.
Ike (SRE): Rollback plan: snapshot control-plane state, cache previous bundle for 72h, record applied migration id. Auto-revert on health-check failure unless customer sets --no-auto-rollback.
Vik (Eng): Prototype CLI:
redwood delta verify bundle.tgz
redwood delta plan bundle.tgz --mode=preserve-mode
redwood delta apply bundle.tgz --customer-approve
Kara (PM): Product knobs: mode={preserve-mode,replace-mode}, apply-mode={shadow,plan,apply}. Default: preserve-mode + plan. Document expected downtime bands for each.
Mona (Eng-Infra): Preflight should output a tiny JSON for gating: e.g. {"vip_ok":"true","egress_conflicts":"[]"}. Obfuscate IPs in telemetry.
Sam (Field): I'll draft a 1-page NetOps runbook (VIP list, firewall ports, bastion steps, approval text) and recruit 2 pilot customers.
Ike (SRE): Telemetry: emit opt-in upgrade_event (id,duration_ms,success_bool). Also log preflight report with obfuscated IPs for debug.
Kara (PM): Prioritization: MVP (next sprint) = delta manifest spec + CLI verify/plan + preflight PASS/FAIL + runbook stub. Stretch = console preview + network-shadow lab util.
ship-bot: Created ticket PRD-1984 "Preserve-mode on-prem delta upgrades" (owner: Kara).
Kara (PM): Action items: Vik->manifest + validator PR by Thu; Mona->preflight prototype by Thu; Sam->runbook draft and pilots by Mon; Ike->rollback playbook by Fri. Sync next Tue 30m to lock acceptance. Thanks!
